_INSTRUCTIONS_FOR_AI.PURPOSE: This is a sample/template for tools/assets-config.json. This file must be PROJECT-SPECIFIC. Do NOT copy this sample directly — replace all values to match the actual app.

RULES.appName: The app's display name as shown in the store listing.

theme.primaryColor: Brand color in HEX. Used in marketing dashboard UI and chart labels.
theme.featureGraphicGradient: CSS linear-gradient for Feature Graphic (1024x500). Should match the app's brand.
theme.screenshotGradient: CSS linear-gradient for the screenshot frame background. Use a dark, premium color.

RULES.setupGuide: Leave folderStructure and example as-is. Only update the description if needed.

scenarios._WHAT_IS_THIS: Defines each screenshot to be captured. Keys must be sequential: '01', '02', ... up to the number of screenshots you need. Google Play allows 4 to 8 screenshots per device type.
scenarios._COUNT_RULE: You MUST define between 4 and 8 scenarios. Define exactly as many as the project needs — no more, no less.
scenarios._name_RULE: A SHORT, CATCHY MARKETING SLOGAN for this screenshot. This text will be printed as the headline overlay on the screenshot image in the marketing template. It must be a compelling tagline (e.g., 'Think Ahead, Win Big!'), NOT a feature label (e.g., NOT 'Game Board' or 'Settings').
scenarios._desc_RULE: A SCREENSHOT CAPTURE GUIDE for the person/automation taking the screenshot. It must describe EXACTLY what state the app should be in when the screenshot is taken: which screen to open, which settings to enable, what data/state to show. This is NOT a marketing description. Example: 'Open the game with AI mode selected, Hard difficulty, 8x8 board, mid-game state with at least 20 stones placed.'
scenarios._suffix_RULE: The suffix key in assets.suffixes must match the scenario key ('01', '02', ...). The value is a short lowercase identifier used in the filename (e.g., 'main', 'gameplay', 'settings'). It must be unique per scenario.

languages._WHAT_IS_THIS: Define one entry per language the app supports. Only include languages actually supported in the app's UI.
languages._code_RULE: Use BCP-47 format as accepted by Google Play: 'ko-KR', 'en-US', 'ja-JP', 'es-ES', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'pt-BR', 'zh-Hans', etc.
languages._title_RULE: The store listing title. Max 30 characters. No promotional text (e.g., no 'Free', 'Best', 'No Ads').
languages._shortDescription_RULE: 80 characters max. One compelling sentence summarizing the app's value.
languages._fullDescription_RULE: Max 4000 characters. Write as an ASO-optimized description: (1) Start with the most important keyword (app name/category), (2) List key features as bullet points or short paragraphs, (3) Include relevant search keywords naturally, (4) Mention unique differentiators. Aim for 300+ characters minimum.
languages._featureSubtitle_RULE: Short tagline for the Feature Graphic overlay (1024x500 banner). Keep under 60 characters.
languages._screens_RULE: An array of marketing overlay texts for each screenshot. The array length MUST match the number of scenarios defined above (4–8). Each entry is the translated version of the scenario's 'name' — a short, catchy marketing phrase.

setupGuide.description: Capture screenshots for each scenario and save them according to the pattern below.

scenarios._comment: EXAMPLE WITH 5 SCREENSHOTS — adjust count (4–8) to match your project needs.

01.name: Your Catchy Slogan Here!
01._name_note: MARKETING SLOGAN: Short, punchy headline shown as overlay on the screenshot. NOT a feature label.
01.desc: CAPTURE GUIDE: Navigate to the app's main/home screen. Ensure all primary UI elements are visible. No dialogs open.
01._desc_note: CAPTURE GUIDE: Describe the exact app state — which screen, what settings, what data to show.

02.name: Every Detail Counts
02.desc: CAPTURE GUIDE: Open the core feature screen with sample data loaded. Show at least 10 data points to demonstrate richness.

03.name: Powerful & Precise
03.desc: CAPTURE GUIDE: Open the settings/configuration dialog. Show key toggles and options in their default state.

04.name: Play Your Way
04.desc: CAPTURE GUIDE: Show a secondary mode or feature. E.g., 2-player mode, dark theme, advanced filter panel open.

05.name: Simple. Beautiful. Fast.
05.desc: CAPTURE GUIDE: Show the result/summary/completion screen. E.g., game over screen with scores, calculation result, or chart view.

suffixes._comment: Keys must match scenario keys ('01'–'08'). Values are short lowercase filename identifiers.
